summary: Mynd.ai, Inc. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) on November 6, 2026, disclosing an ADS ratio change rather than any transactional event. The ratio moves from one ADS representing ten ordinary shares to one ADS representing seventy-five ordinary shares, effectively a 1-for-7.5 reverse ADS split. Effective on or about December 7, 2026, subject to Depositary Citibank, N.A. procedures; trading continues on NYSE American under MYND with new CUSIP 628988206. No ordinary shares are issued or cancelled; fractional new ADSs are aggregated, sold, and net proceeds distributed. An ADS ratio change is a technical adjustment, not a special situation. What to watch: no deal or arbitrage angle; only mechanical price adjustment and potential liquidity/overhang effects from fractional sales.
